headline: BRITAIN'S 🚉 RAILS 🛤️ GETTING RAILED 💥 By 36% Assault SURGE 🥊
text:
BRITAIN'S 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 rail 🚉 services 🛤️ are getting absolutely POUNDED 🥊 by a MASSIVE 🍆 36% 📈 spike 🧨 in reported assaults 🤜 on passengers 👥 and rail workers 🧰 during the year to March 2026 📅 compared with the previous period ⏰!! The Office of Rail and Road ORR 📊 dropped numbers showing violent incidents 🩸 and harassment 😡 rose substantially 🌋 with total assaults against passengers 🧳 and the public hitting a record 13464 🏆 since records began in 2004 🗓️!! ORR called the figures concerning 😟 and said they're edging 🖐️ with the industry 🏗️ to tackle this horny mess of rising violence 🗡️ after five straight years 📈 of increases and awareness campaigns 📣 that still left everyone down bad 😩!!

Harassment shot up 52% 📈 while common assaults climbed 30% 🪜 with each nasty encounter 🥊 potentially logged in multiple categories 📂 like if someone gets verbally railed 😠 then physically handled 👐!! On the workforce side 🧑‍🔧 there were 11289 assaults reported 🛡️ up 12% from last year with 2487 physical beatings 👊 6390 verbal tongue lashings 👅 and the rest straight threats ⚠️!! Richard Hines the ORR's chief inspector 🚨 said they're working hand in hand 🤝 with industry partners 🏭 and trade union colleagues 👷 to understand the risks 🕵️ put controls in place 🛠️ encourage reporting 📝 and give proper support afterwards 🫂 because nobody wants their staff getting manhandled on the daily 🚂!!

Stats cover mainline rail in England 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 Scotland 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 and Wales 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁷󠁬󠁳󠁿 but skip Northern Ireland 🚫 with extra data on London Underground 🚇 trams 🚋 metros 🏙️ and light rail where Underground assaults jumped 20% 📈 to 5534 while workforce incidents dipped 3% 📉 to 3525!! Transport for London records only the most severe part of each messy encounter 🥊 instead of stacking categories like mainline does 📋!! Network Rail and train companies through their spokesperson 🗣️ swore that keeping passengers 👥 and colleagues 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 safe is at the heart 💖 of everything they do with body worn cameras 📹 shared intel 🧠 better reporting 📈 and British Transport Police backups 👮 to investigate support victims 🩹 and drag offenders to justice ⚖️!!

Transport Focus noted the ORR figures back up their own research showing personal security is one of passengers highest priorities 🛡️ yet only 3% said they were dissatisfied with safety at stations 🚉 even while admitting some of the surge might come from better reporting 📝!! Still every single incident hurts someone real bad 😢 and they want a much more strategic approach 🧠 to fixing this rail RAILING problem 🛤️ before it gets worse!! The RMT union 📣 representing workers said their own surveys show two thirds of members have been on the receiving end of violence 🩸 at work which lines up perfectly with these stats 📊!!

RMT general secretary Eddie Dempsey demanded more staffing on public transport including ending lone working 🚫🧍‍♂️ to stop the chaos plus stronger legal protections ⚖️ for public transport workers against on the job assaults 🛡️!! He slammed cuts to British Transport Police funding as disastrous 💥 and called for outsourced security to be brought in house immediately 🏠 as a matter of urgency because the current setup is leaving everyone exposed and down horrendous 😵!! Overall these numbers paint a picture of Britain's rails getting aggressively handled 👐 year after year with 11 members of the public dying at level crossings 🚧 this time six more than before eight pedestrians 🚶 and the rest road vehicle users 🚗 which just adds to the whole unhinged mess!!
